build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a dynamic ball above a static bar obstacle
create_static_bar_obstacle: create a static bar obstacle with configurable width and horizontal position using C.add
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball with fixed scale positioned at a given x coordinate and height
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the obstacle using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.SINGLE_OBJECT indicating a single-object solution
